name: Robust Retrieval Under Distribution Shift
goal: Make the paper ready for submission: a clear contribution on the first page, convincing and honestly reported experiments, calibrated claims, verified references, and compliance with the venue's page limit and anonymization rules.

checks.notes: venue-rules.md lists the page limit, template, anonymization and required checklist sections. The placeholders for the skill directory and the bibliography are filled in automatically; the committee also runs both checkers on the unit in every round and on every file of the paper in each global round, with online citation verification.
